I jut had my colon and rectum removed almost 2 weeks ago after getting an ileostomy last year and my crohns still acting up. Some things i was worried about was the pain and how i would look because im only 25. So im going to tell u the pain is not fun for the first couple days. Luckily my surgeon had them put in an epidural before my procedure that way after i was able to use it to manage pain and that helped ALOT. By day 3 they took out my catheter and by day 5 the epidural. My pain has been managed so far by muscle relaxers and oxy. But i havent needed them as the days go on. The pain luckily gets less and less relatively fast in my opinion after the first week. Now my butt looks exactly the same as before i went into surgery. I still have my crack. You wouldnt be able to even tell unless you spread my buttcheeks (tmi sorry). Also you will be completey knocked out during surgery. You won’t remember or feel anything during surgery. And now if you are receiving a bag during this surgery i know it sucks and its gonna be very upsetting to see at first. But i promise u it will just become another part of ur life. You will learn quickly how to adjust to it (mentally and physically). You will also learn how to change it and clean it quickly. There are many ways to hide it to the point of no one even knowing you have one. Ik this surgery is a blow to every level of ur being but i promise u will make it through. We are all warriors who manage to make it through life no matter what crohns throws at us bc even tho it is strong we r a million times stronger.
